I bought the aluminum single-dose hopper for my Barista Pro. Build quality is outstanding. However, from the moment I put it on, I have experienced a static problem that I never had while using the original plastic hopper. The grinder chute and (original Sage/Breville) dosing funnel are covered in grinds every time I use the grinder. I'm wondering if the aluminum hopper causes static, and maybe I should have bought the plastic version. I have no idea why, but the original plastic hopper never caused static in the beans. All said and done, the build quality is amazing.
